sections.title: Maine real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate transfer tax rate
rows.value: $2.20 per $500 (or fraction) of the value transferred
rows.note: Applies to deeds and to transfers of a controlling interest in an entity owning Maine real estate.

source.title: Maine Revenue Services: Real Estate Transfer Tax

rows.label: Who pays the transfer tax
rows.value: Half by the seller (grantor), half by the buyer (grantee)
rows.note: Collected by the county or regional register of deeds.

source.title: Maine Revenue Services: Real Estate Transfer Tax

rows.label: Additional transfer tax on value over $1 million
rows.value: Additional $3.80 per $500 (or fraction) of value above $1,000,000
rows.note: New for transfers on or after November 1, 2025 (PL 2025, c. 388). Combined with the base rate, $6.00 per $500 on the part above $1 million.
